// diamondAddress: Diamond proxy address on the target network (required)
// migrationInputFile: Path to validated migration input JSON from prepareMigrationInput.ts (required)
// chunkSize: Number of quotes per migration transaction (default: 50)
// dryRun: Log operations without executing transactions (default: false)
// strict: Stop immediately on any failure instead of continuing (default: false)
// progressFile: Resume file path -- re-run the script to continue from last successful operation (default: ./scripts/upgrade/output/migration-progress.json)
